notes: kb/Work PB369, PB5080, PB5139. Rule text (cite.py --check "§2023:14.9.21.3 SR2" "shall contain a GLOBAL clause" -> OK). The rule begins at 2002 (§2002:14.8.20.2 SR2, §2014:14.9.20.2 SR2, word for word; each checked with cite.py --check), so the row's editions are 2002, 2014 and 2023. At 2002 and later a contained program's INITIATE of a container's GLOBAL report whose FD is not GLOBAL is refused COBOL2392 (RejectContainedReportFile, shared with GENERATE and TERMINATE), the message citing the rule of the edition compiled; a non-GLOBAL report of a container is not visible at all (13.18.27.4 GR2) and draws SR1's 'shall be defined by a report description entry'. 1985 has no such rule: its INITIATE asks only that report-name-1 be defined by a report description entry (§1985:XIII.4.4.3 SR1) and a global name may be referenced without describing it again (§1985:X.4.6.4 GR2), so --std 85 accepts the program (unit:GlobalReportScopeTests.AContainedReportVerbOnAGlobalReportWhoseFileIsNotGlobal_IsAcceptedAt1985; kb/Work PB5080).
